name: TC-932: the branding page shows the restaurant's saved logo, hero image and tagline
description: Opening /admin?tab=restaurant&section=branding&restaurantId=<id> renders the saved logo and hero as image previews (src = the saved URL, not the 'No image set' placeholder), the button reads 'Change image', and the Tagline field holds the saved tagline.
descriptionHtml: Opening /admin?tab=restaurant&section=branding&restaurantId= renders the saved logo and hero as image previews (src = the saved URL, not the 'No image set' placeholder), the button reads 'Change image', and the Tagline field holds the saved tagline.
statusMessage: RestauNax PR #1036 (app bug batch) is not on this environment yet (the branding page shows no saved logo)
